item.title: Performance and Accountability Report: Fiscal Year 2026
item.description:
What GAO Found
GAO made significant accomplishments in FY 2026, as detailed in this Performance and Accountability Report for Fiscal Year (FY) 2026. In the spirit of the Government Performance and Results Act, this annual report informs Congress and the American people about what GAO has achieved on their behalf.
This report describes GAO's performance measures, results, and accountability processes for FY 2026. In assessing its performance, GAO compared actual results against targets and goals that were set in its annual performance plan and performance budget, and that were developed to help carry out its strategic plan. An overview of GAO’s annual measures and targets for 2026 is available here, along with links to a complete set of its strategic planning and performance and accountability reports.
This report includes a performance and financial snapshot for the American public for FY 2026, a letter from the Acting Comptroller General, and five parts.
Part I: Management's Discussion and Analysis. This section includes a statement attesting to the completeness and reliability of the performance and financial data in this report and the effectiveness of GAO’s internal control over financial reporting. It includes a summary of GAO’s mission, organizational structure, strategies used to achieve its goals, and processes for measuring performance. It also discusses GAO’s agency-wide performance results and use of resources in FY 2026. It also includes information on management challenges, external factors that affect the agency’s performance, and future challenges and priorities.
Part II: Performance Information. This section includes details on GAO’s performance results by strategic goal in FY 2026 and the targets for FY 2027.
Part III: Financial Information. This section includes details on GAO’s finances in FY 2026, including a letter from the Chief Administrative and Financial Officer, audited financial statements and notes, and the reports from GAO’s external auditor and Audit Advisory Committee. This section also includes an explanation of the information each of the financial statements conveys.
Part IV: Inspector General's (IG) View of GAO's Management Challenges. This section includes the GAO IG's perspective of the agency's management challenges.
Part V: Appendixes. This section provides the report's abbreviations and describes how GAO ensures the completeness and reliability of the data for each performance measure.
Why GAO Did This Study
As a legislative branch agency, GAO is exempt from many laws that apply to executive branch agencies. However, GAO generally holds itself to the spirit of many such laws, including the Government Performance and Results Act and the Federal Managers' Financial Integrity Act. Accordingly, the FY 2026 Performance and Accountability Report provides information on GAO's work, which it considers comparable to that reported by executive branch agencies that choose to prepare annual Performance and Accountability Reports in lieu of separate Agency Financial Reports.
For more information, contact Rebecca Gambler at gamblerr@gao.gov.
